cards.title: Family Healing After Sexual Abuse Disclosure
cards.body: When a family member discloses childhood sexual abuse, prioritize making them feel safe and heard at their own pace. Consider the ongoing risk the perpetrator may pose to younger family members and seek appropriate support.

cards.title: The Emotional Reality of Empty Nesting
cards.body: Watching your first child leave for university triggers unexpected grief, despite knowing it's a natural life stage. Parents often experience denial and confusion about these intense feelings of loss.

cards.title: Parenting at Music Festivals with Young Children
cards.body: Bringing toddlers to music festivals creates a unique family experience that enriches the event rather than detracts from it. Parents can navigate festival life while maintaining the joy and spontaneity of family time.

cards.title: When Child Development Signals Immune System Issues
cards.body: Sudden behavioral changes in children may indicate immune system involvement rather than purely psychological factors. Recent research suggests clinicians should consider physiological causes when a child's behavior shifts dramatically overnight.

cards.title: Family-Centered Mental Health Treatment Reduces Admissions
cards.body: Treatment approaches involving family members and prioritizing patient goals can significantly reduce hospital admissions for mental health crises. Continuity of care with the same clinicians and support from loved ones proves effective.
